_comment: Copy this file to accounts.json and fill in your channels. Each account is one YouTube channel you own. Put each channel's client_secret.json into accounts/<name>/ (the bot runs Google's auth flow on first upload and saves token.json there). Per-account watermark: 'watermark'/'watermark_enabled' = bottom LIKE & SUBSCRIBE banner; 'top_watermark'/'top_watermark_enabled' = light channel-name at the top. NOTE: the watermark only renders in 'render' process mode; 'copy' mode keeps the original Short untouched.
